title: Thue–Morse Lorenz knots
why: Linear volume growth needs lower bounds beyond twist-number upper bounds for Lorenz braids; hyperbolicity of specific Lorenz families is delicate.

title: Chaos in the symmetric ABC flow
why: Chaos only numerical; Ziglin-type nonintegrability exists but rigorous positive entropy likely needs computer-assisted horseshoe.

title: Integrability of the egg-crate torus
why: Finite Fourier spectrum defeats Poincare/Kozlov resonance arguments; claim for every epsilon, including large, has no available method.

title: How nearly can tetrahedra close up
why: Exact exponent is a random/pigeonhole heuristic; proving it needs optimal Diophantine/spectral-gap results (Sarnak-type) open even in SU(2).

title: Sup norms on the Fermat quartic
why: Sogge-Zelditch (analytic surfaces) reduce maximal growth to a point where all geodesics loop back at common time; ruling that out is concrete.

title: Capacities of the 4D superball
why: Non-toric, not a small perturbation of the ball; strong Viterbo only known near ball and for special classes.

title: Charge on a Fermat conductor
why: No explicit density; locating exact global extrema of equilibrium charge on a non-ellipsoid has essentially no tools.

title: Free-boundary disks in a superball
why: Equivariant min-max (e.g. Z3 about diagonal; plane x+y+z=0 is not free-boundary) plausibly gives one, but disk/embeddedness control is hard.

title: Riesz-transform Schrödinger equation
why: 2D mass-critical with skew nonlocal term, no coercive energy; large-data H^1 global existence lacks a priori bounds.

title: Euler with reversed stretching
why: Regularity analogue of 3D Euler on T^3 with sign-flipped stretching; no known structure making it easier.

title: Reflected Lane–Emden in five dimensions
why: h=u(x)-u(-x) is harmonic with bounded spherical L1 means, so constant and odd, hence 0; then Gidas-Spruck forbids u^2 in R^5.

title: KdV with a cosine coefficient
why: Energy not coercive without L2 control and L2 not conserved; global well-posedness for this mKdV variant is open-looking.

title: Burgers with degenerate critical dissipation
why: Degenerate critical dissipation at one point; neither Kiselev-Nazarov-Volberg modulus nor shock constructions directly apply.

title: Permanent–Ampère equation
why: Elliptic but not concave, Hessian may be unbounded; Nirenberg's 2D Liouville needs bounded Hessian, Jorgens tricks need MA structure.

title: Mirror-competition KPP
why: w=u(x)-u(-x) solves w_t=w_xx+w exactly, so w=e^t G_t*w0 with w0 odd nonzero; sup w grows like e^t/poly(t), and u>=w.

title: Keller–Segel on the cube
why: Troyanov's singular Moser-Trudinger constant 8pi(3/4)=6pi gives global existence; localized virial at a cone point gives blow-up. Standard.

title: Lane–Emden with a shift
why: Shift breaks Kelvin transform and Gidas-Spruck structure; p=2 exceeds Serrin exponent 5/3 so test-function methods fail. Plausibly no solutions.

title: Damped waves on a cube
why: Decay rate depends on how a vanishes near the top-face edges (order-of-vanishing results of Kleinhenz, Sun), which is unspecified.

title: Scattering on the cube corner
why: Requires redoing Dodson's mass-critical scattering on a scale-invariant cone without translation symmetry; Strichartz on cones known.

title: Thue–Morse quantum walk
why: Substitution-coin walks studied via transfer-matrix power-law bounds (Damanik-Fillman-Ong); TM trace-map/bounded energies make full exponent plausible.

title: Three-body mean-field rotors
why: Invariant plane theta1=theta2 gives pendulum solution; Morales-Ramis normal variational equation computation is routine.

title: Four vortices on a square torus
why: Ziglin proved nonintegrability of 4 vortices in plane; torus version with Weierstrass Green function plausibly similar but not done.

title: Chaos in the double pendulum at every energy
why: Small energies need exponentially small splitting near elliptic point; high energies near-integrable free rotors. Every energy is far out of reach.

title: Two-frequency localization
why: Bourgain-Goldstein multi-frequency localization only for a.e. frequency and coupling above unspecified threshold; specific sqrt2,sqrt3 and lambda=10 open.

title: Spikes at the squares
why: Gaps 2m+1 make block phases quadratic in m (skew-shift-like cocycle); deterministic localization for such kicks is open-hard.

title: Jacobi matrix of primes
why: Prime gaps unbounded, so Dombrowski's difference conditions and Janas-Naboko bounded-variation criteria fail; genuinely open.

title: Quartic oscillator ground state
why: Irrationality of a specific non-explicit spectral constant; no methods exist (like irrationality of generic analytic constants).

title: Chirp potential threshold
why: V=W' with W~-lambda cos(x^2)/(2x); ground-state transform yields effective -lambda^2/(8x^2), Kneser threshold 1/4 gives sqrt2; standard.

title: Multiplicities on the Fermat quartic
why: Absence of accidental degeneracy for one specific metric; generic simplicity (Uhlenbeck) gives nothing for explicit surfaces.

title: Frozen vortices for Kuramoto on a cube
why: Construct pinned vortex/antivortex or phase-locked state with all edge differences below pi/2; plausible, needs explicit construction.
